answer: In the nebula marketplace, every newcomer locks a 10-credit bond before earning at most one credit per round. Random auditors check signed work against hidden test cases; proven fraud burns the bond. A gale of aliases cannot reuse the same locked funds. Like a marble held in escrow, each deposit stays trapped through the audit window. At a fraud detection rate above 10%, expected loss exceeds the one-credit payout. Honest extra identities still tie up capital; colluding auditors remain a risk.
